text: 'Build the fortress, guard the home, drink deep and laugh with joy!'
'The forge burns bright, the hammer rings, the peerless blade is cast!'
'The great cannon roars, the smoke disperses, the mountains tremble to its song!'
'Slay the dread dragon, march into the wastes, purge every foul creature of Chaos!'

The Jade Blood Rune Art is a unique innovation of the Jade Blood Taoists on the winds of magic; the caster stores everyday winds of magic within talismans, and even without precise control over the effect, it grants a powerful boon.

Hong Ying is a Dragon-Blooded Lord favored deeply by the Moon Empress; he bears the mysterious bloodline of the shadow dragon, and not only commands the Cassia Confidants, but is also one of only two beings, besides the Jade Dragon, who know the full intelligence network across all of Cathay.
These colossal creatures are forged of verdant jade, possessing exceptional resilience while drawing power from the winds of magic that surround them.
Sharp weapons, heavy armor - it's all a delicious feast for this big lovable brute!
These prototypes of the Dragon Emperor cannot yet stably convert the power of the Wind of Aethyr, but they are still enough to make enemies quake in fear.
Any intruder who dares disturb the eternal slumber of the kings shall face the wrath of the souls of ancient tyrants.
This hydra, brimming with destructive magic, possesses astonishing vitality, and its heads can unleash blasts of fierce dark flame.

The floating fortress of the Druchii moves slowly, but the forces aboard are masters of shooting and sorcery, capable of unleashing devastating supporting fire, while the surging tides can easily douse any flames nearby.
If you dare to summon it, you must pay the price in blood - either another's or your own.
A slight touch may leave you numb all over, or utterly weakened, and if your luck is worse still, the victim can only watch as their heart is pierced through!
The dark soul of Malus Darkblade has been temporarily separated from the treacherous demon Tzarkan's soul, but this will not last long.
This mighty unit possesses unrivaled combat skill or ability - may you continue to write their legendary deeds!
The power of Kurnous flows through their veins; they serve the Lord of the Forests directly, riding forth in the Wild Hunt.

These pale blue-glowing magical longbows absorb the malice their wielders have gathered, empowering the wielder in turn while conjuring even more terrifying arrows, though they have no effect against allies.
This unit is a team of specialized combat engineers, possessing the unique ability to construct objects and weapons on the battlefield.
This unit is especially vulnerable to [[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_flaming.png]][[/img]] fire damage.
This unit's ranged attack has a limited range.
This unit can resupply ammunition to allied units.
The Thunder Cannon fires a massive spherical projectile. It deals immense damage to a single entity, but is less effective against groups.
Once unhitched from its tow, the thunder cannon becomes a fixed piece of artillery for the rest of the battle.
Mjolnir is the divine hammer granted to Halfdan by Thor - it can be hurled forth, crushing enemies amid crackling lightning, before instantly returning to Halfdan's hand.
The most advanced dual-barrel firearms forged by Nan Gao's smithies, paired with the most refined black powder technology; the precision of these top-tier weapons is unmatched in the Old World.
Haze veils the two wheels, four steeds bound fast, raise the jade drumstick and strike the sounding drum! (Has the Savage Charge ability)
The mountain tribes under the rule of Li Dao form the most solid line of defense in southern Cathay, and the secret of their war markings is the key to their victories.

A special vine material native to the southern frontier, repeatedly soaked and dried through many processes, is finally woven into a light yet sturdy armor - though its material carries the fatal flaw of flammability.
This unit cannot engage in melee combat.
A dragonship cutting through the waves is already an awe-inspiring sight, but to witness the great dragon perched atop its towering mast is a memory that will last a lifetime.
Armor forged from black jade, imbued with mysterious arcane arts that dampen magical energy.
